name: film_alley
text:
EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT. Rain falls through the neon.
MAYA walks in and stops by the table. She picks up the mug. A stranger steps out of the shadows. "You lost?" he asks. Maya hands him the mug. The stranger throws a punch. Maya blocks and hits back with a cross. He swings a hook; she ducks. She kicks him in the stomach. He falls.

name: film_park
text: EXT. PARK - DAY. ANNA walks up to Tom. She hands him a bottle. "Thanks," Tom says. He drinks.

name: film_gym
text: INT. GYM - NIGHT. JACK circles. Leo jabs. Jack slips and hits back with an uppercut. Leo kicks him. Jack falls.
